content:
We have mass spectrum data: m/z values with intensities. Need to identify elements definitively based on isotope distribution patterns visible. We need to look at isotopic peaks spacing and relative intensities to infer which elements present.

Given peaks from 276.0666 up to 284.0793. The pattern likely corresponds to a molecular ion with isotopic distribution due to elements like C, H, N, O, S, Cl, Br etc. Need to identify elements that can be definitively identified from pattern.

We need isotopic distribution of common elements. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution tool.
